Scholarship overview

Wellington's Research Mobilisation Doctoral Scholarship supports research with a mobilisation focus. It is a defined university funding route for eligible New Zealand citizens and residents, with selection governed by the scholarship conditions and the proposed doctoral work.

Research Areas

  • Research mobilisation
  • Doctoral research
  • Knowledge exchange

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 32,000/year plus domestic tuition

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityNew Zealand citizens or residents
Further conditionsNew Zealand citizens/residents; research mobilisation focus.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026
LocationNew Zealand

About Victoria University of Wellington

Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington offers doctoral research through its schools and faculties. Its scholarship routes include research mobilisation funding with specific residency and project requirements.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.wgtn.ac.nz/scholarships/current/research-mobilisation-doctoral-scholarship

Source: wgtn.ac.nz - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 November 2026, 16:30 NZDT - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Review the eligibility criteria carefully; applications outside the stated scope are usually rejected at the first screening stage.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 November 2026, 16:30 NZDT. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
